department: John A. Reif, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Newark College of Engineering

deadline.value: The department page gives no application deadline.

gre_general.value: The civil engineering department makes the GRE optional but recommended, with a quantitative score of at least 155.
gre_general.quote: The GRE (general section) is optional but recommended of all applicants with a minimum 155 in the quantitative section.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page does not state how many admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants usually hold a master's degree, though highly qualified bachelor's holders can enter directly in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: This is a program for superior students with master’s degrees in civil engineering or allied fields

also.quote: In exceptional circumstances, highly qualified students with bachelor’s degrees in civil engineering may be accepted directly into the doctoral program

notes: The department also lists Ph.D. programs in environmental engineering and transportation engineering (catalog). Their rules were not checked separately. The page gives a TOEFL score of 79, but the quote contains a zero-width character so it is not recorded.
name: Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (also Environmental Engineering and Transportation PhDs)
